text: Artificial Intelligence is developing quickly, and experts often discuss the future of general AI. General AI refers to systems that can perform any intellectual task a human can do. When AI reaches human-level ability across many areas, we call it AGI, or Artificial General Intelligence. AGI could bring major benefits, such as solving health problems, improving education, and helping with scientific research. However, there are also serious risks, including job loss, misuse by criminals, and difficult ethical questions. Predictions about when AGI will arrive vary widely. Some experts believe it may come within 20 to 30 years, while others think it is much further away, or may never happen at all.
